name: Uncompressed Colour Image Dataset
description: An uncompressed image dataset intended as a benchmark for evaluating colour imaging algorithms and metrics.
evaluation_method: PSNR / SSIM / color-difference metrics (ΔE) and subjective perceptual evaluation
general_score_metric: color-difference (ΔE) and PSNR/SSIM depending on task
reputation: A specialized, well-cited resource in color-imaging research but not widely used for large-scale ML benchmarks.
notes: Small, specialized dataset of uncompressed images; primarily for color-imaging algorithm evaluation (non-LLM). May lack large-scale diversity and modern scene variety.
